title: Dental and Vision Savings Memberships Refund Terms by Plan
content:
# Refund Terms by Plan — Dental and Vision Savings Memberships

| Membership | Money-back period | Cancellation after the money-back period ends the membership | Partial refund of the current month (monthly billing) | Refund basis on annual billing | Refund issued within | Fee charged twice for the same period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Smile Savings Individual | 30 calendar days | End of the paid period | No | Unused full months prorated | 10 business days | Credited in full |
| Cascade Smile Savings Household | 30 calendar days | End of the paid period | No | Unused full months prorated | 10 business days | Credited in full |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual | 30 calendar days | End of the paid period | No | Unused full months prorated | 10 business days | Credited in full |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Household | 30 calendar days | End of the paid period | No | Unused full months prorated | 10 business days | Credited in full |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual | 30 calendar days | End of the paid period | No | Unused full months prorated | 10 business days | Credited in full |
| Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household | 30 calendar days | End of the paid period | No | Unused full months prorated | 10 business days | Credited in full |

## Meaning of each column

- **Money-back period:** the calendar days after the enrollment date during which the member may cancel for a full refund of all fees paid.
- **End of the paid period:** after the money-back period, a cancellation ends the membership on the last day of the period already paid.
- **No partial refund of the current month:** after the money-back period, a monthly member receives no refund for the current month.
- **Unused full months prorated:** after the money-back period, an annual member is refunded the annual fee multiplied by the number of unused full months and divided by twelve.
- **Refund issued within:** the business days within which a refund is issued.
- **Credited in full:** a fee charged twice for the same period is credited in full.
